notes.title: On Your Tail giga update 1.1.1 is now live
notes.content:
We're happy to announce that the new On Your Tail update is [b]L I V E  N O W[/b], and it's a massive one! We've been working hard for the last two months and ahead of the Nintendo Switch release to improve the game as much as possible following feedbacks from our fantastic community.
We've published a roadmap earlier this year, and...

https://steamcommunity.com/games/2132560/announcements/detail/535464867257122842

...we're happy to announce that almost everything in there has been implemented in this update! Withoutr further ado let's dive in and give you some more details!

[h2]Gameplay camera improvements[/h2]
We got some negative feedbacks on the in game camera, and we really didn't see them coming since during development and extensive playtesting no one actually reported it. We take feedbacks extremely seriously and so we worked hard to overhaul the in game camera and give our players a lot of customization options to better suit everyones' needs. In fact, we impleented a full new Camera menu!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/ed3c5eee74e7286844703f2d9b89a703ed82c5da.png[/img]

The new options:
- There are now three different camera presets, both for interior and exterior cameras: Standard, Comfonrt and Cinematic. Youi can change cameras in the menu or change them in real time by pressing H (Keyboard) or L1 / LB.
- Camera control acceleration
- Camera damping both on movement and on rotation
- Full FoV and camera distance from the player control: this is extremely useful if you're playing on an ultrawide screen!
- We've also fine tuned the mouse sensitivity slider.

The game now starts with better presets that should mitigate potential motion sickness problems.

[h2]❤️❤️Love everyone update❤️❤️[/h2]
As promised on Valentine's Day, you can now romance and kiss all the four love interest in the game. You don't have to choose: you can kiss everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/c60f8c475e1383dc9706b388684e0e806d4ab275.png[/img]
[i]Smooooooooooch![/i]

[h2]Improved performances - engine update to Unity 6[/h2]
In preparation for the Switch release, we did a ton of work on the under the hood to optimize the game. First of all, we updated the engine to Unity 6. This will help us down the line to optimize the game even further and to push visual fidelity higher. Aside from other massive optimizations, we're reworked our world streaming system to minimize performances problem while loading different areas of Borgo Marina: on Steam Deck you should get higher frame rates across the board and almost zero stuttering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/934042d51cd3a1f4cb24167e62f54a4bf30677a8.png[/img]

[h2]Improved translations and extra dialogues[/h2]
We improved some sub par translations, specifically we completely reworked the [spoiler]Chea's riddles[/spoiler] translations. We've also added some new dialogue lines to better explain some part of the story.

[h2]Gameplay tweaks and balancing[/h2]
Lots of improvements big and small to make your stay in Borgo Marina even more pleasant:
- More Jocker Cards during the investigations: you can get more cards, but also use more to solve the puzzles if you're stuck.
- Increased the number of fishing zones and more money from fishing and harvesting ingredients.
- Fishing tweaks to make the mini game easier.
- Improved cooking: we've made the minigame easier and changed some difficult inputs
- You can now quit some previously un-quittable mini games!
- Mind Palace improvements: added icons to better show when an activity has been completed (stargazing, cooking, movie watcing etc...).
- Added the ability to open the quest log in the map screen.

There are a lot more smaller tweaks that will improve your experience with the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/676bacaf7210a606c7d5e8f7d1402b4c72e43bb2.png[/img]
[i]It's now easier to get those pesky onions...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/610b2edb31474d1ee64441540ca18a9f1285ad85.png[/img]
[i]You can look at the quest log with the map open: how convenient![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/13ea2da2b899ad58c0a4aff763940a03f6c8ab71.png[/img]
[i]New icons added to better keep track of your progress![/i]

[h2]Added visual details and tweaks[/h2]
We've added some small visual tweaks and detail to make your stay in Borgo Marina even more unforgettable: a rotating lighthouse beam during the night, to fully animated clocktower hands (bells are next!) to much improved water rendering...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/265e4f48456bf609a5d407febe86050433b6d112.png[/img]
[i]Tick tock, tick tock![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/1339ff0ee496ce4f336e99b035cce30515cdfd92.png[/img]
[i]More watery water and more wavy waves...[/i]

[h2]What's missing...[/h2]
We still have to implement full key remapping. It's something we'll definitely do but it still requires a bit of work! Apologies for this, we'll keep you up to date.

[h2]🪳🪳Oh, almost forgot! We also fixed bugs! Lots of bugs!🪳🪳[/h2]

We really hope you'll enjoy this update and that you'll all have an even better experience in Borgo Marina! We have more updates coming!

Thank you for your support!
The Memorable Games Team

notes.title: On Your Tail - The road ahead
notes.content:
So we launched On Your Tail a bit over one month ago, 2025 is just started, and this is the right time to share with you some cool informations about our future roadmap for the game!

First of all, a [b]H U G E thank you for your support[/b]: we've currently got over 100 reviews with a Very Positive rating on Steam, this is an amazing result for us!
Now brace yourselves, we have a lot of stuff coming...

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
We've already released 8 patches for the game - yikes!-, greatly improving the game stability and squashing a ton of bugs. On Your Tail is complex and big and we're a small team, so sadly some bugs and edge cases caught us off guards at launch.
We'll continue fixing bugs until the game is 100% stable!

[b]Improved translations[/b]
Some in game translations in various languages are sub par or wrong (for example: Chea's Riddles), and we're working to fix it.

[b]Performance improvements + migration to Unity 6[/b]
On Your Tail already runs very well on Steam Deck and on low powered hardware, but we've been working hard ot optimize performances even further.
First of all, we're migrating the game to Unity 6, harnessing the increased performances and optimizations of the new version of Unity.
At the same time, a lot of the optimizations we've introduced for the Switch version have been implemented in the game. Our goal is to offer a perfecly smooth experience, boosting the frame rate further and ironing out some fps dips while roaming through Borgo Marina.

[b]Nintendo Switch version[/b]
As announced, the Switch version of On Your Tail is coming soon!
We'll share a release date as soon as it's set in stone.

[b]Quality of Life improvements[/b]
We've been watching the community suggestion closely, here on Steam and on the official game Discord, and we've started working on some much needed QoL improvements for the game:
[olist]
[*]Camera optimization and more options: we're working hard to implement better camera controls and more options to alleviate the motion sickness problem experienced by some players.
[*]Harvesting mini game improvements: we'll rebalance the mini game, making it easier, and we'll add more harvesting point
[*]Fishing rebalancing and improvements
[*]Extra dialogues to better explain some part of the story
[*]Joker Cards rebalancing: a lot more Joker cards will be available to use during investigations and puzzles
[*]Improved cooking: we're revising some interactions to make them easier and more intuitive
[*]Mind Palace improvements: added icons to better show when an activity has been completed (stargazing etc...)
[*]Added the ability to open the quest log with the map
[*]The ability to quit some mini games
[*]More visual and accessibility options
[*]Full key remapping
[/olist]
We still plan to add some form of fast travel in the game, but we need to find the right way to do it.

And now the juicy part...

[h3][b]Extra content and DLCs[/b][/h3]
While it's a bit too early to share specific info, our goal is to expand the game with extra content and DLCs: On Your Tail has been structured in such a way that, aside from the main story, is easy to expand.
We plan to expand the existing activities, add more activities and mini games, more interactions with your friends, more investigations, new locations to explore, expanded relationships and extra romance.
We'll also add more outfits, accessories and extra props to decorate your room.
As soon as we have our plans set in stone, we'll share all the informations! That's a promise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/b8fadb34662d8197445eecd67a61f2accce74b90.png[/img]

Thanks again for all your support and don't forget to leave a review here on Steam if you've enjoyed the game!

The Memorable Games Team

notes.title: On Your Tail Patch 1.0.4 is live now with lots of improvements!
notes.content:
Hey there!
As anticipated, the team is hard at work in fixing and improving the game as much as possible, and we have an hefty patch ready for you today, full of fixes and QoL improvements!

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the 'fall though the world' bug when walking around Borgo Marina
[*] Fixed a lot of translations errors in various languages
[*] Fixed some conditions preventing to end the [spoiler]"Bambina Scomparsa"[/spoiler] mystery.
[*] Fixed some missing Achievements
[*] Added some missing cards to the Mind Palace
[*] Fixed the Camera clipping plane (it was too near)
[*] Fixed the button to remove the UI with the Camera equipped
[*] Fixed the ability to properly reset some settings both in game and in the main menu
[*] Fixed a potential soft lock at dinner time [spoiler]after going out to see the falling star with a friend[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed some issues in the Mind Palace
[*] Removed the D-PAD on screen glyph when the player has no tools
[*] Fixed an issue while leaving the Ice Cream shop with an ice cream flavour
[*] Fixed the romance with [spoiler]Peina[/spoiler]. If done as the first romance tha player was given no choice and had to kiss her, preventing future romances.
[*] Fixed a cheat with the piggy bank
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the player to get the Level 2 fishing rod. If you get the fishing rod Level 3 first, Level 2 unlocks automatically. If you're already unlocked the Level 3 fishing rod, just talk to Chea to get the Lefel 2 fishing rod.
[*] Lots of other small bug fixes.
[/list]

[b]Quality of life improvements[/b]
We've added some 'soft' fast travel options during the story! While it's not a full fast travel implementation, this will require more time, those fast travel point should help while playing the story:

[list]
[*] After [spoiler]solving the Villa di Orlando Theft mystety[/spoiler] at Chea you can back to the Villa immediately.
[*] After [spoiler]finding the Fidato's villa gate closed[/spoiler] you can fast travel back to Chea immediately.
[*] After [spoiler]ending the Mystery at Forte Esterin[/spoiler] you can fast travel back to the Docks
[*] After [spoiler]finding the Lexua's boat and the fallen tunnel[/spoiler] you can fast travel back to Villa De Montoni
[*] After [spoiler]ending the Lexua's interrogation you can fast travel back to Villa Fidato[/spoiler]
[*] After [spoiler]taking the final picture of Borgo Marina for Paun[/spoiler] you can fast travel back to the Foto e Foto shop
[/list]

[b]Ultrawide support[/b]
We're striving to offer full ultrawide support in the future, but it still needs a lot of improvements. In this build, we've unlocked all the resolution options, so you should be able to play the game with your native screen resolution. You may have some visual glitches, but it's a first step!

Thanks for all your support and for staying in touch with us and reporting bugs! The game is big but we're trying our best to fix as many as possible in the shortest timeframe possible and to improve the game following your suggestions.

The Memorable Games team

notes.title: On Your Tail runs great on Steam Deck!
notes.content:
On Your Tail is the perfect game to play on an handheld, enjoying its relaxing atmosphere under the blankets, which is why we wanted to make sure the game ran to its full potential on Steam Deck.
And the game runs great indeed!

First of all, you don't have to change any visual settings: the game will run at max settings by default on Deck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/f008b0bd91d458e81ad0ad6444f9ac16d554f040.jpg[/img]

You can run both at the full Steam Deck resolution 1280x800 or at classic 1280x720. Performances are not impacted, but running at 720p can avoid some UI and video stretching problems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/94b5b9033760dd3746835816deb2f524b2c7a86d.jpg[/img]

Visual settings are already at max, aside from MSAA which is disabled. MSAA visual impact is minimal on the Steam Deck screen and pushing it to 8x can be taxing, so we suggest to leave it Off.

You can then tweak the Steam Deck settings to either push for max battery life or max performance.

[b]Maximize Battery Life[/b]
If you opt for Max Battery Life you can tweak some parameters in the Steam Deck Performance settings to achieve over 7 hours of gameplay.
First of all, press the ... button, go to the Performance tab, enable Advanced View and then set:
- Enable Use per-game profile
- Frame Limit: 40FPS
- TDP Limit: 7 Watts
- GPU Clock: 800Mhz

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/85b4f4f597b02042db3ec3c905786ca1d6c43945.jpg[/img]

This will let you play the game at stable 40fps, while preserving Battery Life. Of course you can dim the Steam Deck screen to achieve even better results.

[b]Maximize Performances[/b]
So you really want to play On Your Tail at 90fps on your Deck? No problem, you can do it while limiting power consumption too: you should be able to easily reach 4 or more hours of gameplay with these settings.
Use these Performance settings:
- Enable Use per-game profile
- Frame Limit: 90FPS
- TDP Limit: 10 Watts
- GPU Clock: 1200Mhz

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749611/fbf5924688bb10f4b829af491e113f84201d2582.jpg[/img]

Obviously you can experiment with settings and run the game at 60fps with minimal impact.

Hope you'll enjoy your stay in Borgo Marina... on your Steam Deck!

notes.title: On Your Tail (PC) Review
notes.content:
Something that dawned on me while playing On Your Tail was just how little we get content with anthropomorphized animals. Back in the day, Disney’s bread and butter were movies where the main characters were some form of anthropomorphized animal, but nowadays, with the exception of Zootopia it’s a concept that has really faded from the mainstream—I blame the internet.

It’s really a shame because it’s such a fun idea that allows for easily digestible storytelling and almost immediate visual shorthand for the world and characters. And while On Your Tail doesn’t really take this as far as it could, it still delivers an enjoyable experience packed with personality and genuine intrigue.

Players take on the role of Diana, a university student and aspiring writer struggling with her creative writing course. When her professor advises her to gain lived experiences to bring more heart to her work, she sets out for the seaside village of Bourgo Marina.... Read more

notes.title: Take a mystery lover's holiday by solving crime on the Italian Riviera in On Your Tail
notes.content: I'm used to mystery games where the mystery is the main thing. In Strange Horticulture you may be running a shop while trying to figure out what's going on in Undermere, but you don't have to balance the books between trying to figure out how a druid got poisoned. You're not going to suddenly get a game over because a national chain of weird plant shops opened up a franchise across the road from yours... Read more.
